submitted.rationale: Index 15 (Sb 0.715) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00242%. Measured EQE was flat, about 0.002% from Sb 0.31 to 0.72, then fell to 0.0011% at Sb 0.865. XRD at indices 12 and 15 shows PbSb2O6 (mp-20727) as the best-matching phase (similarity about 0.47–0.49), plus extra peaks from an unidentified second phase. The final EQE measurement went to index 12, the peak predicted by a quadratic fit and by the GP, but it came in lower at 0.0020%.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.0020%, below index 15. It was the quadratic-fit and GP choice for the peak.
